title: Chapter 559
text:
The speed of the main cannon was extremely fast, and he had already been locked onto. There was no point in dodging on the ground. It only took a few milliseconds for the cannon to hit him. Even Degulish and the other two would have to dodge before the cannon fired.

Unable to ride on the BlackLight Stealth, Han Xiao did not expect to be able to dodge the attack of the main cannon with his own speed. Void Travel might be able to dodge one shot, but as long as the main cannon of the Dark-star mothership was activated, it would definitely not stop at one shot upon seeing him dodge.

Rather than that, he might as well make use of the limited time he had to stack up his defenses and use [Recoil — Thorns] as a safeguard. He would first try to tank the first shot and figure out the damage of the main cannon. With so many measures, his chances of survival were still very high. If he could tank the first shot, he would be able to bluff and scare the enemy.

As this thought flashed through his mind, a terrifying energy reaction suddenly descended. The moment he sensed it, the attack had already arrived.

He was in the fortress and could not see the scene of the main cannon descending. He could only feel the layers of shields shattering from the feedback of the Mechanical Force. Countless mechanical soldiers were destroyed, and the fortress above his head quickly changed shape. Following which, a bright light filled his vision, and a terrifying heat covered his entire body.

Boom boom boom!

A huge force came crashing down like a mountain, and Han Xiao was instantly slammed to the ground. He was enveloped in the energy pillar of the main cannon, and his vision was completely white. The endless stream of energy was like a waterfall, pressing down heavily on his body and sinking into the ground.

His health dropped rapidly. Even with the additional thirty percent damage reduction, the first wave had taken away a third of his health. The subsequent high temperature and energy shockwaves caused continuous damage, and his health dropped rapidly. Han Xiao could not move at all, and he felt as if all the flesh on his body was melting and evaporating. All sorts of debuffs appeared one after another.

If it were an ordinary person, they would have been reduced to ashes in one shot.

He gritted his teeth and activated [Intermediate Cell Proliferation Control], recovering 28% of his HP at the highest rate possible. Only then was he able to keep up with the rate at which his HP was dropping. He was only slightly slower. His HP bar continued to jump, causing his heart to palpitate. He was prepared to use the Aurora Character Summon Card at any moment.

He recovered over 10,000 HP every second, which was equivalent to expending two to three thousand Energy Points every second. Fortunately, while the main cannon was dealing damage, it was also continuously replenishing his Energy Points, maintaining his HP regeneration ability.

Damage notifications popped up crazily on the interface. Originally, the mothership's main cannon still had a portion of high True Damage, but with [Steel Body]'s ability, it was very crucial. It could be said that it had greatly reduced the speed of his HP loss. Han Xiao only suffered normal damage.

…

A few seconds ago.

After shooting down another assault ship, Nagojin's entire body was wrapped in flames. He hovered in the air for a short while and looked at Han Xiao's battlefield from afar. The shock in his eyes could not be concealed.

Black Star really withstood the siege of three Calamity Grade Supers. How did he do it?

Nagojin was very shocked. He knew that he could not do it.

At this moment, he noticed that there seemed to be a change on Han Xiao's side. He saw that Black Star was rapidly stacking his defenses, while the three Dark-star Calamity Grades were running far away, as if they were avoiding something dangerous.

"Why aren't they fighting? Is Black Star guarding against something?"

Nagojin's face was filled with doubt. Before he could think, the sudden change gave him the answer.

Shua!

A thick beam of light descended from the sky and hit Han Xiao's position. Calling it a 'hit' was not accurate. The thick beam of light directly covered an area of a few hundred meters around Han Xiao!

From the time the beam of light pierced through the clouds to hitting the ground, it took less than the blink of an eye. Even with Nagojin's reaction speed, he did not have the time to react. He could only subconsciously squint his eyes to resist the strong light.

Bang!

This shot blasted out a crater in the blink of an eye!

The beam of light was like a divine spear, piercing straight into the ground. It gave off the illusion that it would pierce through the entire planet. The impact was extremely strong!

The strong light was so blinding that Nagojin could barely open his eyes. His expression changed drastically.

This is the mothership of Dark-star.

The main cannon of a spaceship?

Are the people of Dark-star crazy? They actually used their main cannon to deal with a single person!

How did Black Star provoke them?

Rumble —

The next moment, a violent explosion shot up into the sky. The wind suddenly blew, and countless dirt and debris were sent flying in all directions by the shockwave.

The main cannon of the Dark-star mothership used a separate energy furnace, and its power was many times higher than the light cannons of the assault spaceships. Relatively speaking, the mothership's main cannon was considered a 'single target' attack in galactic combat. Of course, if the main cannon was used to hit a single target, the effect would be no different from an AOE.

The main cannon continued to fire, and the terrifying heat distorted the air. Shockwaves burst out, and the area covered by the beam of light had already turned into a crater, and the area was still rapidly expanding.

Inside the protective shield, the faces of countless players were illuminated by the white light. Their faces were lifeless, and only the beam of light remained in their sight.

This, this is … justice from the heavens?

Whoosh!

The main cannon stopped firing, and the last beam of light landed in the center of the crater.

Boom!

All of a sudden, the accumulated energy exploded. The sound was even louder than before. Flames and dust spread out at high speed, like a constantly expanding cover. Whistling hot winds swept out!

The earth trembled!

Everyone hiding inside the protective shield also felt the intense tremors, and they swayed from side to side.

After a while, the explosion of energy finally stopped, and the dust obscured their vision. Everyone could only see the crater outside the Sanctuary, as if it had been hit by a meteor.

"What … is this?"

Countless players were shaken.

Bennett was speechless.

Hella threw herself onto the protective shield, and her pupils constricted.

Nagojin stood at the top of the protective shield, and his face was filled with anxiety as he looked at Han Xiao's original position. That was the center of the crater, and dust was everywhere.

Degulish, Ashes, and Terry stood up, and their faces were covered in dust. They had run a little further before the cannon fired and were only sent flying by the shockwave, landing in different places. After standing up, they all looked toward the center of the crater, eager to confirm the outcome of the battle.

The Dark-star assault spaceships and Godora spaceships had all stopped firing and were hovering in the air, observing the situation.

The dust gradually dissipated, and the center of the crater was caved in for who knew how many meters. The slope was extremely steep, and the deeper it went, the redder the soil became. Many places had been turned into crystals by the high temperature, and some rocks had melted into lava that was over a thousand degrees Celsius, giving off a white glow as it flowed down the slope.

Countless mechanical fragments were scattered around, and a portion of them had already melted into molten iron.

In the center of the crater, a figure slowly crawled up. His entire body was charred black, and smoke was coming out of his body. He shook his body a few times, and the charred skin on his body fell off, revealing his normal skin color. He raised his hand and shot out a bolt of Mechanical Force, changing the shape of a few mechanical fragments and covering his lower body like a pair of pants.

Han Xiao's muscular upper body was exposed, and he held the back of his neck with one hand as he cracked his neck and smiled.

"Phew … that's more like it. I feel like my body is stretched out."

Everyone's eyes were focused on Han Xiao. Everyone was looking at him.

Not … not dead?

The lively Black Star formed a huge contrast with the crater beside him.

This scene made Degulish, Ashes, Terry, Nagojin, Hella, and the other players feel an immense impact, and their eyes widened in shock.

…
